BEWARE OF THIS ESTABLISHMENT
Feb 2023 • Friends
BEWARE OF THIS ESTABLISHMENT!!! 
The only time I felt physically unsafe on the entire two week trip around Vietnam and Cambodia was in the presence of the so-called manager of this establishment. The person who called himself the manager was also our waiter. Apart from the fact he got most of our order wrong and the food we did get was average, at best, he charged us for more drinks than we had had and a meal that they had forgotten to add to someone else’s bill (the couple had already left the restaurant). When we challenged our bill, he became verbally aggressive and menacing - he called me a liar when I said that we were not on holiday with the people whose bill he had got wrong - he said he had CCTV proof that we had been talking to them, so therefore, we had to pay for their meal. We had no choice but to pay, as this person was so menacing. I have read other reviews of this establishment that tell similar stories to our own, where people have been forced to pay for things they haven’t had. I would not recommend this place to anyone. The food is average, the service is dreadful, the prices are high and, in my experience, the waiter/manager is aggressively rude and actually menacing .

Depends on the staff ... but I'd go elsewhere 'cos it's not worth the risk
Jan 2023 • Friends
Had a few beers here with a couple of blokes I'd only just met. I was paying for my shout as we went, and he was paying his at the end ... as he had done for the previous couple of days. All was going well ... and I would have given it 4 stars... until there was a change of staff. 
I ordered 2 more beers and, as I had been doing, was going to pay for them at the time. Next thing I know, the female staff member got stuck into me and accused me of not paying for drinks. She was incredibly (nastily) aggressive and accused me of lying. First time in my life I've experienced that reaction. We tried to explain to her that the 2 drinks that hadn't been paid for were on the other bloke's tab and he was quite happy to settle the bill to calm her down - which he offered to do several times. That had no impact on her whatsoever. Eventually another staff member came across and it was sorted out ... exactly as we tried to explain to her.
We're all staying nearby for a few days, and I would have been quite happy to adopt this place as my "drinking hole" whilst I was here - as the other bloke's had - but after this episode, that's not going to happen - for any of us. There's too many other places around that treat you with respect to come back here.
The only reason I gave it a 2 instead of a one rating was because of the earlier service.
